how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-tirisfal-glades-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:354:obj:0: Bring Gregor's Remains, Nissa's Remains and Thurman's Remains to Coleman Farthing in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:354:details:0: The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in ⟦E2⟧. I used to work their mills...before the Plague.
rows.quest:354:details:1: BWhen the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend. We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.
rows.quest:354:details:2: BThe Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath. And now they are minions of the Scourge!
rows.quest:354:details:3: BServe the ⟦E3⟧ by defeating the Agamands who fell to the Plague. Serve me by bringing me their remains.
rows.quest:354:completion:0: ⟦E4⟧ has a sweet taste, don't you think? When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them? I hope so. I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.
rows.quest:354:completion:1: BIt is a foolish hope, I know. But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.
rows.quest:355:details:0: You have given me the remains of the Agamands, and satisfied my desire for revenge. But the Agamand Mills hold a threat to all the ⟦E3⟧, not just to me.
rows.quest:355:details:1: BI have spoken to Magistrate Sevren of your exploits against the Agamands, and he wishes to speak with you.
rows.quest:355:completion:0: Coleman speaks well of you, ⟦1⟧, telling of your successful forays into the Agamand Mills.
rows.quest:355:completion:1: BThe ⟦E3⟧ have need of your talents once again...
rows.quest:356:obj:0: Kill 8 ⟦E5⟧ Horrors and 8 Wandering Spirits, then report back to Linnea at her camp.
rows.quest:356:details:0: The defenders on The Bulwark protecting Tirisfal from the ⟦E6⟧ are on constant alert. But sometimes Scourge will slip past them.
rows.quest:356:details:1: BOur success at the Bulwark depends on a one-front battle - we cannot allow an attack from the rear, nor can we allow our defenders' supply line to be cut.
rows.quest:356:details:2: BAssist the Bulwark. Patrol east and slay any Scourge you find. Spend particular effort at the Balnir Farmstead to the east. It has become a haven for interloping Scourge.
rows.quest:356:completion:0: Very good. Your efforts do much to keep the Scourge at bay. A commendation will be sent to my superior, Executor Zygand.
rows.quest:358:obj:0: Kill Rot Hide Graverobbers and Rot Hide Mongrels.
rows.quest:358:obj:1: BBring 8 Embalming Ichors to Magistrate Sevren in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:358:details:0: The Mass Graves, southwest of Garren's Haunt to the north, were made to accommodate the...impressive...number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the Plague first came.
rows.quest:358:details:1: BThe bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide Gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies. This cannot be allowed!
rows.quest:358:details:2: BYour task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the Mass Grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the Embalming Ichor that gives them life.
rows.quest:358:completion:0: Expertly done, ⟦2⟧. The Scourge are mistaken if they think they can use those corpses against us, and the fluid you gathered from the Rot Hide slaves will be studied by our Apothecaries. It may have secrets we can use against them.
rows.quest:358:completion:1: BAs I said, well done. But our struggle continues, and the conflict will surely offer you more chances to prove your worth to the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:359:details:0: I need a fresh report from our Deathguard waystation to the east.
rows.quest:359:details:1: BI must know if more Scourge forces have slipped past The Bulwark and into Tirisfal. Our vigilance on the border to the ⟦E6⟧ must be maintained - we can't let the Scourge get a stronger foothold here!
rows.quest:359:details:2: BTravel south along the road, then east at the fork to the waystation. Speak with Deathguard Linnea. She has the information I need.
rows.quest:359:completion:0: Magistrate Sevren wants a report? Very well: the defenders at The Bulwark are holding the majority of the Scourge at bay, but some do slip through on occasion.
rows.quest:359:completion:1: BWe have seen sporadic Scourge activity east of this station, with a concentration around the Balnir Farmstead.
rows.quest:360:details:0: Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you. He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.
rows.quest:360:details:1: BAnd if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.
rows.quest:360:completion:0: It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark. The Lich King and his minions are ceaseless in their assaults.
rows.quest:360:completion:1: BBut we will not give in. He will not take us again!
rows.quest:361:obj:0: Find Yvette Farthing, and deliver to her the letter from Thurman Agamand.
rows.quest:361:details:0: This is a letter written by Thurman, the eldest son of Gregor Agamand. It is addressed to an Yvette Farthing, though it does not appear to have reached her...
rows.quest:361:completion:0: Oh...my poor Thurman! I begged him to leave Agamand Mills with me and my father, but his family loyalty was too strong! And I knew it! I just knew it that Brand meant him harm!! Oh, curse this Plague, and the Scourge!
rows.quest:361:completion:1: B<Yvette's face then smoothes and grows cold.>
rows.quest:361:completion:2: BBut regrets are for the weak. As a ⟦E3⟧, I have new goals and love is not one of them. I would thank you for delivering this letter, for I had wondered what happened to my past love.
rows.quest:361:completion:3: BBut that life is over. Forever.
rows.quest:362:obj:0: Slay Devlin Agamand, and bring Devlin's Remains to Coleman Farthing in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:362:details:0: Devlin Agamand was the younger of two sons in the Agamand family, and in life the two could not be more different. Thurman was tall and gentle while his younger brother was weak and sharp tongued.
rows.quest:362:details:1: BWhen Agamand Mills fell to the Plague, I was not surprised to hear that Devlin was quick to succumb. His mad chattering can still be heard near the road leading to the Agamand Mills.
rows.quest:362:details:2: BI'm collecting the remains of the Agamands, and I want poor Devlin. Find him, destroy him, and bring me his bones.
rows.quest:362:completion:0: Thank you. Devlin's bones will rest nicely on my mantle.
rows.quest:362:completion:1: BIf my cold heart can find warmth, it is in knowing that the Agamands are destroyed. They failed me and my family when the Plague came - now I swear I will smash their remains under my heel!
rows.quest:365:obj:0: Steal 10 pumpkins from the farm to the west, just north of Deathknell and take them to Apothecary Johaan in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:365:details:0: What have we here? You look like a fledgling ⟦3⟧. If you hope to prove yourself to The Dark Lady, you need to learn the ways of The ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:365:details:1: BTo the west you'll find a farm. Humans infest the land like mold on a rotting corpse. And worse yet, the ⟦E7⟧ patrols nearby from their tower. Teach those scum a lesson and steal 10 of their precious pumpkins.
rows.quest:365:details:2: BOnce you have 10, take them to Apothecary Johaan in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:365:completion:0: You have performed your bidding well, young ⟦4⟧. You are proving yourself to be quite an asset to The Dark Lady's army.
rows.quest:366:obj:0: Return Gunther's Spellbook to him, on the island of Gunther's Retreat.
rows.quest:366:details:0: Long ago Gunther and I, along with the now Scourge Necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, were friends and students within the Kirin ⟦E8⟧ - a society of mages in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:366:details:1: BGunther and I both fell to the Plague, but I thought he either remained dead, or was raised into the ranks of the Lich King. It is good to know he is free.
rows.quest:366:details:2: BWe must have him. I have placed a spell on his book that, when he sees it, will show him that I too am free of the Lich King. After knowing this, it is my hope that he will join us.
rows.quest:366:completion:0: My book?!? So you were the thief who stole it!
rows.quest:366:completion:1: BBut...what is this new enchantment upon it...Bethor? He is in Lordaeron?
rows.quest:366:completion:2: BIf he still exists, then perhaps he too escaped from the Lich King's grasp...
rows.quest:367:obj:0: Apothecary Johaan in the town of ⟦E1⟧ wants you to collect 5 Vials of Darkhound Blood.
rows.quest:367:details:0: Lady Sylvanas has called upon the Royal Apothecary Society. The Dark Lady believes our knowledge coupled with the newfound magic will provide the key to ⟦E10⟧'s demise. She has challenged us to concoct a new plague, a plague deadlier than any ailment on ⟦E11⟧. This new disease will bring ⟦E10⟧'s Scourge Army to ruin.
rows.quest:367:details:1: BMy studies show that the blood of beasts might prove to be the key. Bring to me 5 vials of darkhound blood so I can test my theory.
rows.quest:367:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦5⟧ and I thank you for your efforts.
rows.quest:368:obj:0: Apothecary Johaan of the town of ⟦E1⟧ needs 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:368:details:0: While you were collecting samples for me, my experiments led me to realize that more reagents will be required for this new disease to spread properly. Poisoning some hapless victim is child's play. Plaguing an entire world proves to be a bit more complicated.
rows.quest:368:details:1: BI will need 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in the vicinity. You will find the creatures along the coast to the north or to the west.
rows.quest:368:completion:0: The scales are perfect, ⟦6⟧. Exactly what I needed for this concoction.
rows.quest:369:obj:0: Apothecary Johaan in the town of ⟦E1⟧ wants you to bring him 4 samples of venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider.
rows.quest:369:details:0: While you were out gathering, I uncovered some old text in one of my tomes that indicates that an ancient plague wiped out thousands of innocent victims. Later it was discovered that the deadly agent in the plague was preserved through the venom of Night Web Spiders.
rows.quest:369:details:1: BBring me some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider to complete this experiment. I want to see if the contagious element from the venom will work with my new concoction. Rumor has it the spiders can be found in Eastern ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:369:completion:0: Ah, this venom will do perfectly, ⟦7⟧. Everything else has been added to my concoction and boiled down. Finally, I am ready to try this new deadly agent!
rows.quest:370:obj:0: Executor Zygand in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to kill Captain Perrine, 3 ⟦E12⟧ Zealots and 3 ⟦E12⟧ Missionaries.
rows.quest:370:details:0: The strategic documents from Executor Arren contain all the details we need to wipe the human infestation from the lands. According to the information, The ⟦E7⟧ has assigned Captain Perrine and a brigade to the ruined tower southwest of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:370:details:1: BKill Perrine along with 3 Zealots and 3 Missionaries and report back to me.
rows.quest:370:completion:0: Captain Perrine's death will undoubtedly please The Dark Lady. You have performed your duty well, ⟦8⟧.
rows.quest:371:obj:0: Executor Zygand in ⟦E1⟧ has commissioned you to slay Captain Vachon and 5 ⟦E12⟧ Friars.
rows.quest:371:details:0: We are still at war and the ⟦E7⟧ grows in strength. The report Executor Arren sent me indicates ⟦E12⟧ Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in southeastern Tirisfal near the Balnir Farmstead under the command of Captain Vachon.
rows.quest:371:details:1: BKill Vachon along with 5 ⟦E12⟧ Friars. It should prove to be a devastating blow to the Crusade!
rows.quest:371:completion:0: Captain Vachon's death will slow down the ⟦E7⟧'s advancement in Tirisfal quite a bit. But other threats loom.
rows.quest:372:obj:0: Executor Zygand in the town of ⟦E1⟧ wants you to assassinate Captain Melrache and his two bodyguards.
rows.quest:372:details:0: ⟦E12⟧ Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest. According to the information we have, a ruthless commander named Captain Melrache is in charge of this evil crew.
rows.quest:372:details:1: BI am entrusting you now with a special and dangerous mission. Slay Melrache and his two bodyguards, in the name of The Dark Lady.
rows.quest:372:completion:0: You have done extremely well, ⟦9⟧. With ruthless fighters like you conquering in the name of The ⟦E3⟧ our race is one step closer to defeating ⟦E10⟧ once and for all. I have a good feeling about you, comrade.
rows.quest:374:obj:0: Bring 10 ⟦E12⟧ Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:374:details:0: Executor Zygand tells me you've been out killing ⟦E12⟧ Crusaders. ⟦E2⟧ is crawling with them.
rows.quest:374:details:1: BVarimathras, lieutenant to The Dark Lady, is seeing to it personally that the scum of ⟦E11⟧, the Human race, gets wiped into oblivion. Here in ⟦E2⟧ we face a particularly annoying breed of humans: The ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:374:details:2: BVenture forth and wage an offensive on the ⟦E7⟧, ⟦10⟧. Bring me back 10 ⟦E12⟧ Insignia Rings as proof of your loyalty to Varimathras and The Dark Lady.
rows.quest:374:completion:0: Varimathras would be proud. You serve your leaders well, ⟦11⟧.
rows.quest:375:obj:0: Bring five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread to Gretchen Dedmar in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:375:details:0: It's so cold, now. The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent. The Mindless State will be upon me soon. But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady. When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army.
rows.quest:375:details:1: BNow my hands shake from the chill. If you would bring me five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread I could sew myself a blanket. Help me, ⟦12⟧, so that I can continue to serve the cause.
rows.quest:375:completion:0: I appreciate your efforts, ⟦13⟧. May Slyvanas recognize your bravery one day. . . .
rows.quest:398:obj:0: Kill Maggot Eye and return to Executor Zygand in ⟦E1⟧ with his paw for a reward.
rows.quest:398:details:1: BA foul beast, even by Gnoll standards, Maggot Eye has been sentenced to death for his crimes against The ⟦E3⟧. This despicable villain has been stealing corpses for use by the Lich King's army. Maggot Eye was last seen pillaging the lands near Garren's Haunt to the north of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:398:details:2: BThe town of ⟦E1⟧ hereby offers a reward to the capable soul who can carry out the execution. Show Executor Zygand the villain's paw once the deed is done.
rows.quest:398:completion:0: Maggot Eye's dastardly acts have finally been avenged. Maybe your acts of valor will send a clear message to those who wish to bring harm to our people. On behalf of the town of ⟦E1⟧ I thank you, ⟦14⟧.
rows.quest:404:obj:0: Bring 7 Putrid Claws to Deathguard Dillinger in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:404:details:0: Scourge have trickled into ⟦E2⟧ and have infested the area west of ⟦E1⟧, near the old bridge.
rows.quest:404:details:1: BGo there and beat back the rotting dead and ravaged corpses you find. Scatter their bones and bring back their putrid claws, and the Deathguards will reward you.
rows.quest:404:completion:0: Well done. I regret not being there to see you smash those undead into rotting pulp!
rows.quest:405:obj:0: Present Sevren's Orders to Bethor Iceshard in the ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:405:details:0: Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful mage in the ⟦E13⟧ to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge. You, ⟦15⟧, will be that agent.
rows.quest:405:details:1: BPresent these orders to Bethor. He will then instruct you on your mission. I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich. And it will be dangerous.
rows.quest:405:details:2: BSo ready yourself, ⟦16⟧. You must not fail.
rows.quest:405:details:3: BYou may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:405:completion:0: Ah, you are the agent sent by Magistrate Sevren. Then yes, your business with me is crucial.
rows.quest:405:completion:1: BI trust Sevren has mustered someone suitable for my task...but we shall see.
rows.quest:407:obj:0: Take the Laced Pumpkin to the Captured ⟦E12⟧ Zealot who is being held in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern.
rows.quest:407:details:0: Harmless pumpkins, right? Or so it would seem. If we are to defeat ⟦E10⟧'s advances from the North and the Human infestation from the South we need to start realizing the full potential of our gift of undeath.
rows.quest:407:details:1: BWith a little ingenuity a simple pumpkin becomes an agent for our Dark Lady. This pumpkin, laced with my latest formula, will prove to be quite a treat.
rows.quest:407:details:2: BYet another ⟦E12⟧ Zealot has been captured and is being kept in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern. Take this pumpkin to the fool.
rows.quest:407:completion:0: By the Light! Finally some food! Sweet, sweet pumpkin. . . .
rows.quest:408:obj:0: Kill 8 Wailing Ancestors and 8 Rotting Ancestors.
rows.quest:408:obj:1: BKill Captain Dargol, and bring his skull to Magistrate Sevren in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:408:details:0: The Agamand Mills area has become a foothold for the Scourge. Their strongest point is the Agamand Family Crypt where their local military leader, a skeleton named Captain Dargol, has headquartered. With Necromancy he has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.
rows.quest:408:details:1: BThis cannot pass, and you must stop it. ⟦E14⟧ to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.
rows.quest:408:details:2: BAnd, bring me the skull of Captain Dargol.
rows.quest:408:completion:0: Your actions struck a telling blow against the Scourge. And your victory will not go unnoticed - not by the ⟦E3⟧, nor by our enemies.
rows.quest:408:completion:1: BContinue the struggle as we all do, ⟦17⟧, and one day we will drive the Lich King himself from ⟦E11⟧!
rows.quest:409:obj:1: BSummon Lillith Nefara and kill her.
rows.quest:409:obj:2: BReturn to Gunther on his island.
rows.quest:409:details:0: You say you are not bound by the will of the Lich King, and the enchantment Bethor placed upon my book corroborates this. But before I believe you I must have proof that you are enemy to the Scourge.
rows.quest:409:details:1: BThere is an old, bloody altar just off the southern coast of this island. it is used by a powerful Scourge agent, Lillith Nefara.
rows.quest:409:details:2: BTake a Candle of Beckoning from this crate here. Light it on the altar and Lillith will awake. Destroy Lillith, and I will believe you are the Lich King's foe.
rows.quest:409:completion:0: You have defeated Lillith Nefara, proving you are an enemy of the Scourge. Incredible.
rows.quest:409:completion:1: BI had believed I was the only Undead with free will, but you have shown me there are others who have broken the Lich King's domination.
rows.quest:411:obj:0: Bring the Nether Gem to Bethor Iceshard in the ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:411:details:0: Take this Nether Gem to my old comrade Bethor. It will let us communicate ... and I have much to tell him.
rows.quest:411:completion:0: You convinced him to join us! You have done a great deed for the ⟦E3⟧, ⟦18⟧. The Dark Lady will be informed.
rows.quest:426:obj:0: Gather 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls, then return to Deathguard Dillinger in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:426:details:0: The Scourge are trying to form a base at the Agamand Mills. If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal.
rows.quest:426:details:1: BThe orders have been given. The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed.
rows.quest:426:details:2: BGo to the Mills. Collect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.
rows.quest:426:details:3: BTo get to the Mills, follow the road west. After crossing the bridge, take the next fork north then keep going north. When you see windmills, the battle will begin.
rows.quest:426:completion:0: Your efforts in the war are felt among us, ⟦19⟧. I will not thank you for doing what is necessary, but the Deathguards of Tirisfal will remember your name.
rows.quest:427:obj:0: Executor Zygand of ⟦E1⟧ wants you to kill 10 ⟦E12⟧ Warriors.
rows.quest:427:details:0: The documents Executor Arren provided are just the break we needed in our battle with the wretched ⟦E7⟧. We now know their exact locations throughout ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:427:details:1: BBut the Deathguard has larger concerns. The Lich King's army grows in number each night. We need someone with "initiative" like yourself to drive the ⟦E7⟧ to the grave.
rows.quest:427:details:2: BProve to me you are capable of serving The Dark Lady by travelling west to the tower past the Solliden Farmstead and slay 10 ⟦E12⟧ Warriors.
rows.quest:427:completion:0: Most excellent, ⟦20⟧. Your skill in the art of combat is undeniable.
rows.quest:445:obj:0: Take Apothecary Johaan's findings to Apothecary Renferrel in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:445:details:0: Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas. Surely you know this by now.
rows.quest:445:details:1: BAs a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.
rows.quest:445:details:2: BTake these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in ⟦E15⟧. Follow the roads to the south from ⟦E1⟧. From the ⟦E13⟧ go southwest.
rows.quest:445:completion:0: Ah, how good of Apothecary Johaan to send his research. With so many new developments here in Silverpine, I nearly forgot about the findings coming out of Lordaeron and ⟦E2⟧. Which reminds me, I need to get those samples off to the Necropolis soon.
rows.quest:445:completion:1: BBut you must excuse my rambling. Extend your stay in Silverpine, ⟦21⟧. We could use an able bodied ⟦22⟧ like you around here.
rows.quest:492:obj:0: Bring Johaan's Special Drink to the Captured Mountaineer.
rows.quest:492:details:0: According to the Deathguard, another one of those foolish Dwarven Mountaineers has just been captured. The Deathguard likes to use the cellar of the Gallows End Tavern as a holding cell until prisoners can be "properly" dealt with.
rows.quest:492:details:1: BWhy don't you go see how the Captured Mountaineer enjoys this special drink I made for him? It contains a subtle hint of what The Dark Lady has planned for the rest of ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:492:completion:0: Ah, a drink at last. I'm sure it's no Rhapsody Malt but I'll take anything to whet the old whistle at this point.
rows.quest:5481:obj:0: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the ⟦E1⟧ graveyard.
rows.quest:5481:details:0: Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.
rows.quest:5481:details:1: BWhen you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in ⟦E1⟧ graveyard.
rows.quest:5481:completion:0: What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense.
rows.quest:5481:completion:1: BVery well, you're here now and that's all that matters. Since I'm not going to bother to try to explain things to that abomination how about you collect what I really need... doom weed!
rows.quest:5482:obj:0: Collect 10 Doom Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.⟦23⟧
rows.quest:5482:details:0: So you can see the predicament that I'm in, ⟦24⟧. That thing is out there collecting the wrong weeds! I'll make it worth your while to gather what I need. Bring back to me enough doom weed and I'll give you a suitable reward.
rows.quest:5482:details:1: BIt is my understanding that they like to plague the flora near the mass gravesite, to the north of the ⟦E1⟧ graveyard. Hurry and be mindful of the gnolls in the area.
rows.quest:5482:completion:1: B<Junior Apothecary Holland rubs his hands together greedily.>
rows.quest:5482:completion:2: BThese will come in quite handy. You've done me, uh, the Lady, a fine service today ⟦25⟧. As promised here is the reward that you deserve.
rows.quest:5901:obj:0: Use the Empty Termite Jar on the Termite Mounds in ⟦E16⟧. After you've gathered 100 Plagueland Termites, return to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:5901:details:0: So, to bring pain and strife to the ⟦E7⟧, I want to take their precious lumber mill from them. I'm sure the loss of such a resource will cause them a great deal of harm in defending and rebuilding the town for their own reasons. Will you help me, ⟦26⟧?
rows.quest:5901:details:1: BStart by taking this jar to Plaguewood in the ⟦E16⟧. Fill it with the termites you find in their mounds throughout the woods. Come back when you have enough.
rows.quest:5901:completion:0: These will do nicely, ⟦27⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:5901:completion:1: BIf you're ready, we can get on with the next step.
rows.quest:5902:obj:0: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in ⟦E17⟧ to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.
rows.quest:5902:details:0: Now that we have plenty of termites, take this steel reinforced barrel to the Northridge Lumber Mill south of Hearthglen--you'll find it to the west of the road that leads you up to the town.
rows.quest:5902:details:1: BOnce there, place the barrel in the center of the lumber mill; someplace high, like on a crate or something.
rows.quest:5902:details:2: BAfter you open it, the rest should take care of itself. Just come back here and I'll reward you for helping me.
rows.quest:5902:completion:0: The termites are obviously getting restless as you place the barrel on top of the crate.
